name: sovereign-ai-ibuddy
description: Private-by-default AI reference implementation for sensitive knowledge-work pilots

scripts.setup:offline: npm run setup:core && npm run model:install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:installer && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:backend: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-python.ps1 -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -v
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-python.ps1 -m compileall -q backend
scripts.lint: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-python.ps1 -m ruff check backend && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.format: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-python.ps1 -m ruff format backend
